newsitem.title: PERU: Peru, Colombia launch border anti-drug offensive.
newsitem.headline: Peru, Colombia launch border anti-drug offensive.

text.p: Peru and Colombia announced Tuesday a major anti-drug offensive intended to flush out traffickers and destroy operations around their shared jungle border.
Peru's anti-narcotics police said the operation, under way since the weekend, involved at least 270 officers from both countries, nine helicopters, three planes and 20 boats.
The operation has already brought the destruction of 12 secret landing-strips and the capture of 20 traffickers from both countries, according to Colombian police sources.
